title: AI Parlance — AI-first IR for software generation
description: Write compact .aip specs. The reference toolchain parses, validates, and emits PostgreSQL, OpenAPI, and TypeScript today. Clone the repo, run aip emit, less boilerplate.

hero.title: Intent first.
hero.subtitle: AI Parlance is an AI-first intermediate representation. Humans and LLMs write .aip; official emitters turn Core specs into SQL, OpenAPI, and TypeScript.
hero.note: Reference CLI in the monorepo: aip parse · validate · emit sql|openapi|typescript. Site playground below is illustrative only.

items.title: Smaller AI context
items.body: Edit ~10 lines of .aip instead of hundreds of framework boilerplate per entity.

items.title: Multi-target from one spec
items.body: One validated Core AST already feeds PostgreSQL, OpenAPI, and TypeScript; more targets follow the matrix.

items.title: Built-in domain blocks
items.body: Entities, CRUD, policies, workflows, and events in one predictable structure.

items.title: Validate before generate
items.body: aip validate checks Core specs; aip emit produces Preview artifacts you can review before shipping.

items.title: LLM-friendly grammar
items.body: Controlled syntax helps agents produce consistent specs, not drifting code.

items.title: Honest scope
items.body: Focused on data-oriented APIs and automation — not custom UI or heavy algorithms.

toolchain.title: First official emitters
toolchain.subtitle: Phase C shipped the first reference transpilers from a shared Core AST. PostgreSQL was first; OpenAPI and TypeScript completed the wave.

items.name: PostgreSQL
items.body: DDL from entities — tables, FKs, enums, soft delete. aip emit sql

items.name: OpenAPI 3
items.body: Schemas + CRUD paths (+ auth schemes). aip emit openapi

items.name: TypeScript
items.body: Interfaces, type guards, thin path helpers. aip emit typescript

playground.title: Illustrative demo
playground.subtitle: Quick in-browser preview. For the official toolchain, clone the repo and use aip emit.
playground.disclaimer: Not the official emitters. Official path: npm ci && npm run build, then node packages/cli/dist/cli.js emit sql|openapi|typescript examples/minimal.aip
playground.errorParse: Could not parse spec. Check entity and crud blocks.

cta.title: Try the reference toolchain
cta.body: Clone the repo, run the test suite, and emit SQL, OpenAPI, or TypeScript from examples/minimal.aip.

footer.tagline: AI-first IR · first emitters in Preview.

emittersPage.title: AI Parlance — First emitters
emittersPage.description: The first official AI Parlance transpilers: PostgreSQL DDL, OpenAPI 3, and TypeScript interfaces and guards.
emittersPage.heading: First official emitters
emittersPage.lead: The reference toolchain turns validated Core .aip into concrete artifacts. PostgreSQL was the first emitter; OpenAPI and TypeScript followed from the same AST.

sections.title: PostgreSQL DDL
sections.body: Creates tables with implicit id and timestamps, unique/required constraints, enum checks, and belongs_to foreign keys. Primary SQL target in the docs.

sections.title: OpenAPI 3
sections.body: Emits Entity / Create / Update schemas and CRUD paths. Optional security schemes from app.auth.

sections.title: TypeScript
sections.body: Interfaces plus zero-dependency type guards and thin path helpers — no Nest or Express lock-in.

emittersPage.tryBody: Clone, install, build, then emit from the minimal example.
